questions.prompt: Where is Tell Kom Aziza located?
choices: In the eastern desert of Egypt
Along the banks of the Euphrates River
questions.hintKo: The site is in the western Nile Delta, not near the Pyramids or other locations mentioned.

questions.prompt: What surprising discovery did archaeologists make beneath the human cemetery?
questions.hintKo: The discovery was wild boar burials, not treasure, temples, fossils, or scrolls.

questions.prompt: Why are wild boar burials considered unusual in ancient Egyptian culture?
choices: Boars were too small to be buried
Egyptians only buried cats and dogs
Boars were already extinct in Egypt
Pigs and boars were usually considered impure
Burial was reserved for royalty only
questions.hintKo: The burials are unusual because pigs and boars were considered impure in ancient Egyptian culture.

questions.prompt: Which Egyptian deity may the boar burials be connected to?
choices: Set, the god of storms and chaos
Osiris, the god of the dead
questions.hintKo: The burials may represent ritual sacrifice connected to Set, not Ra, Osiris, Horus, or Anubis.

questions.prompt: How many years of human occupation are preserved at Tell Kom Aziza?
choices: About two thousand five hundred years
questions.hintKo: The site preserves over three thousand years — much longer than the other options.
